capabilities: draw chemical structures and reactions in Ketcher
create and store .ket files in a configured vault folder
link structures so hovering shows a read-only preview
embed structures in notes and open them in Ketcher by clicking
disambiguation: Not a general drawing tool; it is specifically for chemical molecules and reactions stored as .ket files.
extras: Desktop app only. Editor features and shortcuts are documented in the external Ketcher user guide rather than the README.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to draw, view, or embed chemical structures and reactions in notes.
summary: Chemical structure editor that lets users draw and view molecules and reactions in .ket files using the Ketcher web-based sketcher.
